Patch 1.2.10

  • Hotsprings Pond has been added to Login Badges
  • Added 11 new gallant mounts from base vanity mounts and boars/pangolins.
  • Due to repeated issues with our preproduction server, the Supplying the Settlers activity will not come online this week, but next. We wanted to fully test it in all ways possible to ensure it is working as intended. We apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding.
  • Added new titles, some of which are obtainable through achievements...
  • Added lunafrost effect for Perfect Destroyer Lunafrost
  • The Blue Salt Festival in Sanddeep is now active! It'll run until June 26th.
  • The Divine Blessings make a return! You'll have until June 26th to collect Blessings, 4 times a day every 30 minutes!

== Patch 1.2.10 ==

* Hotsprings Pond has been added to Login Badges
* Added 11 new gallant mounts from base vanity mounts and boars/pangolins.
* Due to repeated issues with our preproduction server, the Supplying the Settlers activity will not come online this week, but next. We wanted to fully test it in all ways possible to ensure it is working as intended. We apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding.
* Added new titles, some of which are obtainable through achievements...
* Added lunafrost effect for Perfect Destroyer Lunafrost
* The Blue Salt Festival in Sanddeep is now active! It'll run until June 26th.
* The Divine Blessings make a return! You'll have until June 26th to collect Blessings, 4 times a day every 30 minutes!
